en.t: A lamp was burning near the seats.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“靠着正屋的中柱朝西打横坐着的，正是我的意中人吧。”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "The one sitting sideways facing west, leaning against the central pillar of the main room, must be the woman I long for."

units.source_text: 但见这个人穿着一件深紫色的花绸衫，上面罩的衣服不大看得清楚；

en.t: He saw that this person was wearing a deep purple figured silk robe, though the garment layered over it could not be seen very clearly.

units.source_text: 头面纤细，身材小巧，姿态十分淡雅。

en.t: Her features were delicate, her figure was petite, and her bearing was very quiet and refined.

units.source_text: 颜面常常掩映躲闪，连对面的人也不能分明看到。

en.t: Her face was often hidden or turned away, so even the person opposite her could not see it clearly.

units.source_text: 两手瘦削，时时藏进衣袖里。

en.t: Her two hands were thin and slender, and she kept tucking them into her sleeves.

units.source_text: 另一人朝东坐，正面向着这边，所以全部看得清楚。

en.t: The other woman sat facing east, directly toward this side, so everything about her could be seen clearly.

units.source_text: 这人穿着一件白色薄绢衫，上面随随便便地披着一件紫红色礼服，腰里束着红色裙带，裙带以上的胸脯完全露出，样子落拓不拘。

en.t: She wore a white gauze silk robe, with a purplish-red ceremonial robe thrown casually over it; a red sash was tied at her waist, and above it her breast was completely exposed, giving her a free and unrestrained look.

units.source_text: 肤色洁白可爱，体态圆肥，身材修长，鬟髻齐整，额发分明，口角眼梢流露出无限爱娇之相，姿态十分艳丽。

en.t: Her complexion was fair and lovely, her body was plump, her figure tall and graceful, her hair and coiffure neatly arranged, and her forehead hair distinct; around her mouth and the corners of her eyes there was endless charm, and her whole manner was richly beautiful.

units.source_text: 她的头发虽不甚长，却很浓密；垂肩的部分光润可爱。

en.t: Although her hair was not especially long, it was very thick, and the part that fell to her shoulders was glossy and charming.

units.source_text: 全体没有大疵可指，竟是一个很可爱的美人儿。

en.t: Taken as a whole, there was no great flaw to point out; she was truly a very lovable beauty.

units.source_text: 源氏公子颇感兴趣地欣赏她，想道：“怨不得她父亲把她当作盖世无双的宝贝！”

en.t: Prince Genji looked at her with considerable interest and thought, "No wonder her father treasures her as a matchless jewel in all the world."

units.source_text: 继而又想：“能再稍稍稳重些更好。”

en.t: Then he thought again, "It would be even better if she were just a little more composed."
